name_note: The genus is also written Candidatus Scatocola, and most of its GTDB species are uncultured genomes without published names.

sentences.text: Scatocola faecipullorum was among the top species detected in models of faecal samples donated by 6242 participants of the Finnish FINRISK cohort.
In that cohort the association of Scatocola faecipullorum with incident autoimmune rheumatic disease did not reach statistical significance after correction for multiple testing.
In a bullous pemphigoid-like mouse model, a gut taxon belonging to Scatocola was identified as a candidate negative predictor of disease severity.
